title: Palindromic Permutations Generator

monster.name: Mirror Banshee
monster.title: Reconstructor of Symmetric Words
monster.defeatQuote: All palindromic permutations assembled around the central axis!

description: Given a string `s`, return all the palindromic permutations (without duplicates) of `s`. If no palindromic permutation could be form, return an empty list.
solutionCode:
def generatePalindromes(s: str) -> list[str]:
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(s)
    odd_chars = [ch for ch, c in counts.items() if c % 2 == 1]
    if len(odd_chars) > 1: return []
    mid = odd_chars[0] if odd_chars else ''
    half = []
    for ch, c in counts.items():
        half.extend([ch] * (c // 2))
    half.sort()
    res = []
    used = [False] * len(half)
    def backtrack(curr):
        if len(curr) == len(half):
            prefix = ''.join(curr)
            res.append(prefix + mid + prefix[::-1])
            return
        for i in range(len(half)):
            if used[i]: continue
            if i > 0 and half[i] == half[i - 1] and not used[i - 1]: continue
            used[i] = True
            curr.append(half[i])
            backtrack(curr)
            curr.pop()
            used[i] = False
    backtrack([])
    return res
